statement: The turtle boundary is the only intrinsically immovable thing. Everything else is a body with mass; immobility exists only through the turtle, gluon anchors, or KINEMATIC solver mode. Nothing is ever placed or ends below the turtle plane beyond SLOP.
mechanism: assert_above_turtle at the particle doors + kg door (TURTLE_STRICT abort, TURTLE_LENIENT to inventory); enforce_turtle_boundary
origin: CLAUDE.md engine invariant; 55 below-turtle placements found 2026-08-10

statement: No two bodies interpenetrate beyond SLOP (1 mm) in steady state. Penetration resolves across frames at bounded speed; it is never accepted as rest state and never resolved by teleport.
mechanism: split-impulse position pass with SLOP tolerance; MAX_BIAS_VELOCITY bounds on repair speed
origin: settling/penetration gates; the 72 m/s wedged-boulder ejection RCA

statement: Energy is never created. Kinetic, potential and elastic strain energy may only transform into each other or into dissipation; the total never rises except through sanctioned external input (gravity, drives). A solver operation that adds energy is a bug wherever it hides.
mechanism: energy ledger (ENERGY_LEDGER=1): per-substep d_TOTAL by row type; equal-and-opposite momentum door
origin: owner's reframe 2026-08-10: energy is not lost, we transform it; Baumgarte-injection RCA

statement: Every generated structure, at frame zero and before a single solver iteration, has every bond at strain 1.0 (measured attachment-to-attachment) and no overlap beyond slop. No solver change can hold a structure that arrives already broken.
mechanism: frame-zero audits (test_tree_bonds_born_at_rest pattern); GENERATION_DEBT_LEDGER G1-G6
origin: generation-debt campaign 2026-08-10..12

statement: Compliance, soft constraints and spring-damper models exist only as physical models (OrganicGluon). Adding a spring or damping to suppress penetration, oscillation or a boundary symptom is forbidden; the mechanism underneath must be fixed instead.
mechanism: review discipline + the derivation law (INV-9) removing declared spring constants
origin: CLAUDE.md engine invariant

statement: Every correction derives from contact geometry, never from a world-up axis. Every mechanism must work on walls, ceilings and in zero-g. Floor-Z clamps, push-up heuristics and axis biases keyed to world-Z are forbidden.
mechanism: contact normals from geometry; review discipline; turtle plane is geometry (a plane), not an up-vector
origin: CLAUDE.md engine invariant

statement: The question 'can this body receive momentum' has exactly one answer, from one predicate (massless, sleeping, KINEMATIC: no), and every velocity write passes equal-and-opposite through one door. A sleeping body never gains velocity from any subsystem.
mechanism: inv_mass_momentum + apply_pair_impulse in physics_system_v4.cpp; position repair keeps its own deliberate predicate
origin: deeper-law campaign 2026-08-12: the sleeping-branch 6.74 m sink RCA

statement: No constraint row applies impulses sized for a different world than the one at solve time. Effective masses never exceed what the live immovability predicate allows; rows built before a wake shrink to the live state before solving.
mechanism: row mass refresh (shrink-only) for contact and gluon rows at solve start; manifold mass split (eff/N per same-normal row)
origin: 245 m/s blade RCA + heel-strike ±110 m/s RCA, 2026-08-12

statement: Organic bond force laws derive from material and geometry: axial k = A/(La/Ea + Lb/Eb), damping from loss factor, bending K = E*I/L. A force-bounded bond with no force law refuses to build. There is never a second declaration for the derivation to disagree with.
mechanism: derive_organic_force_law + refuse_undeclared_bond at both bond doors; GLUON_LENIENT=1 for inventory
origin: G6: 28 hollow branch bonds standing a canopy on nothing

statement: Any threshold, cap or exit criterion compared across bodies is expressed in a quantity with the same physical meaning at every mass: velocities, or momenta scaled by the mass they act on. A raw impulse threshold means a shrug to a branch and a shove to a leaf, and is forbidden.
mechanism: convergence exits, impulse-memory caps (m_light * max bias velocity), angular caps (I_light * max angular bias)
origin: light-body campaign: 1046:1 ratio ladder, 2026-08-11..12

statement: No body exceeds the speed ceiling, leaves the world, or gains kinetic energy in a discontinuous jump. The explosion detector is always on; its warnings are failures, not noise.
mechanism: explosion detector (speed/energy/escape tripwires, frame-stamped), PHASE 8, always compiled in
origin: issue #42 tripwire; every detonation RCA of the campaign

statement: Contact normals and points come from bodies' actual oriented shapes. A rotated box collides as a rotated box, rests flush on its true faces, and sheds oblique loads sideways; nothing collides as its axis-aligned bounding slab.
mechanism: OBB SAT narrow phase with reference-face clipping; oriented bounds in broad phase and turtle down-reach
origin: walk-gate snowplow + settling_flat 276 mm RCA, task #40

statement: A driven joint converges to its commanded pose and holds it under its own load, without standing error beyond the test budget and without oscillation. The controller never fights a second controller: no integral terms stacked on drives.
mechanism: quat-drive rows + honest angular exits + scoped angular split impulse + FK/drive boundary contract; failed integral attempts preserved as evidence commits
origin: shoulder standing-error RCA, task #41

statement: Bonds tear only under genuine geometric strain, measured attachment-point-to-attachment-point against the bond's own rest, at or beyond the tear ratio. A bond between two satisfied resting bodies never tears.
mechanism: tear law with rotated-offset rest; TEAR_DEBUG frame-stamped evidence lines
origin: foliage tear-at-rest RCA; the measure-what-the-bond-enforces lesson (G1c)

statement: The solver reads solver_mode and physical state only. No ParticleOwner or game-category branch exists inside src/core/physics_*.{h,cpp}; ownership bookkeeping lives in the systems that need it and is invisible to the solver.
mechanism: static audit (grep for owner reads in physics translation units); 28 cross-layer reads removed 2026-04-18
origin: CLAUDE.md architecture boundary

statement: A body constrained at an anchor rotates about that anchor, not about its centre: the row's inertia is the anchor-axis inertia (I_com + m*r_perp^2) and every angular impulse carries the coupled linear velocity so the anchor point does not move.
mechanism: NOT YET SHIPPABLE: needs one row carrying a full Jacobian (independent scalar rows measured unstable: blade tore at 99.6 m/s). The diagnosis and the failed formulation are documented at physics_solver.h (PIVOT LAW comment) and physics_system_v4.cpp ~:3003.
origin: rotation-ladder rung 3: +3.3 rad/s of drive against -3.3 of anchor correction, net 0.001, forever (the blade that would not stand up)

statement: A contact may stop an approach; it may never amplify one. A contact is a passive element: it does no positive work, so no pair leaves a contact separating faster than it was closing plus the support cushion. This is conservation of energy specialized to contacts (restitution <= 1); amplification is energy creation.
mechanism: per-row impulse budget effective_mass * (|approach| + CONTACT_CAPTURE_CUSHION); MECHANISM A, issue #47
origin: the 675 m/s two-gram sheet; owner ruling 2026-08-13: name it as the energy-conservation consequence it is

statement: Sleep is a cache over dynamics, and this is its coherence contract: a sleeping body's geometry, overlaps, bond strain and support are evaluated exactly as an awake body's, and every state change that invalidates its equilibrium is a dirty hit that wakes it. INV-7 is the momentum half; this is the geometry half.
mechanism: wake-on-strain, wake-on-break, wake-on-mutation at every mutator (SetMass shipped; SetMaterial, force registration, gluon mutation, swap/removal, chunk load listed unaudited)
origin: the 2.35 m invisible bond error (117x the wake threshold); owner framing 2026-08-13: sleep is a masked cache, apply dirty hits with strategies

statement: Damping exists only where a real dissipation process is being modeled: a material converting kinetic energy to heat, which leaves the system and is booked as dissipated. It acts only on relative motion within a pair or deviation from a bonded cluster's mean, never on absolute motion (Galilean invariance: a bonded cluster in free fall accelerates at g). Damping added for numerical convenience, stabilization, or outside a physical dissipation story is forbidden.
mechanism: reduced-mass damping impulse through the momentum door; loss-factor-derived coefficients (INV-9); dissipation bucket in the energy ledger (pending, see ledger)
origin: the 1 m/s terminal-velocity bonded boulder; owner ruling 2026-08-13: damping only when real dissipation is happening, never out of physics

statement: A constraint row is priced and applied with the same inverse-mass and inverse-inertia model. Pricing in one metric and spending in another delivers momentum the books never saw: it is momentum non-conservation by bookkeeping, and it is silent.
mechanism: apply with the same effective mass the row was sized with; the row mass refresh keeps both live
origin: the 13.9 m one-substep blade teleport, invisible to every detector; owner ruling 2026-08-13: ground it in momentum conservation

statement: Geometric repair is sanctioned approximation: we cannot simulate the microscopic contact physics, so constraints get wiggle room to adjust between the cracks. The bounds: repairs move positions through discarded pseudo-velocity and NEVER enter real momentum; corrections stay below the noticeable-effect threshold (micro-corrections well under ~300 ms; adjustments resolving over a few frames are acceptable, instantaneous teleports are not). An error that cannot close must never compound into velocity.
mechanism: universal split impulse; bias caps; SLOP tolerances; the perceptual bounds are to be tuned in play (owner: 'we need to play and take all this into account')
origin: the 3.7 -> 61 m/s ratchet; owner ruling 2026-08-13: a necessary hack, bounded to imperceptibility

statement: Every interacting pair is governed by exactly one mechanism at a time and no violation is corrected twice. This follows from the momentum door: a second corrector applying to the same violation is unbooked momentum (double dose), and from single-source-of-truth: two owners of one pair will disagree. Bonded-structure-internal pairs generate no contact rows; no pair gets rows from both orderings; a boundary-repaired violation is not repaired again.
mechanism: pair dedup; bond_root union-find skip; turtle-row exclusion from the position pass
origin: the (i,j)/(j,i) double-impulse explosions; owner ruling 2026-08-13: state it as derived, name the sources

statement: A row no finite impulse can change (both endpoints immovable) contributes exactly zero and is excluded from every stopping test and residual maximum. No solver exit may be held hostage by a question with no answer.
mechanism: eff_mass 0 for immovable pairs; exclusion from convergence metrics; counted and reported separately
origin: S22: one immovable diagonal pair pinned 14,000 bodies forever

statement: Every corrective mechanism terminates: it carries a tolerance below which it does nothing. At steady state a scene performs zero corrective work; a correction that fires forever on the same body is a perpetual-motion machine pumping energy uphill in nanometre installments.
mechanism: SLOP tolerances on every repair (position pass, turtle boundary); corrective-firing counters on settled scenes must read zero
origin: 1955 firings of 290 nm each on a scene at rest, PE climbing; the first energy-neutral scene (d_TOTAL == 0 exact)

statement: Every narrow-phase handler produces the contact normal in one documented direction, and every contact leaving physics is oriented A toward B with approach negative while closing. A convention with two answers turns every consumer into a coin flip; this is the convention by which the engine makes sense of physics' effects.
mechanism: per-handler contract in narrow_phase.h; orientation normalization at the physics boundary
origin: the avoid-obstacle push that drove the humanoid INTO the wall

statement: Every position error, whatever row type carries it, is corrected at BETA * error / dt bounded by a velocity cap. No row type has its own dialect. Sibling of INV-10: that one demands the same meaning across masses, this one across row types.
mechanism: one bias form for contacts, gluons, angular rows; the three declared caps (linear, gluon, angular), all 4.0
origin: gluons missing /dt were 30x weaker than contacts at the same error: grass could not hold (124-650 mm standing gaps)

statement: The same scene stepped the same number of times in the same build produces bit-identical state, given identical seeds. All randomness enters through declared, seeded channels only (future dice throws and probabilistic effects are sanctioned THROUGH such channels, never through incidental nondeterminism). Reproducibility is the instrument every other invariant is measured with; an unreproducible violation is a rumor.
mechanism: test_physics_characterization runs the scene twice in-process and demands bit identity; A-vs-A control before any golden number
origin: characterization discipline; owner ruling 2026-08-13: design for seeded randomness, never incidental

statement: An attachment point and a bond's rest geometry have exactly one definition, computed by one function, with both offsets rotated by their own body's full orientation. Four hand-copies of this math exist today and one disagrees; this invariant is the bridge between software architecture and the physics: shared physical definitions are shared code.
mechanism: one helper, all call sites, grep-enforced; runtime cross-check that all consumers agree on the same bond to float tolerance
origin: 51 bonds torn with both bodies stationary from a rest measured in a frame that exists nowhere (G1c)

statement: The physics engine contains not one magic number. Every constant with physical meaning is a named, grouped, documented INPUT that prepares and adjusts the engine to work in an explicit way: declared outside the code that uses it, unit-annotated, and injected explicitly. Tweaking, adding, deleting or grouping constants is an explicit effort separated from writing the code that consumes them. Engine and constants are totally decoupled. This keeps the code honest and the dev effort honest: no hacks hidden in literals, underlying mechanisms pursued rather than higher-level patches tuned. INV-9 governs what must be DERIVED from materials; this governs everything legitimately declared: it is an engine input, never an inline number.
mechanism: physics constants registry in the physics schema, generated into the engine (LinkML gen-cpp-header); static gate: no bare numeric literal with physical meaning in physics translation units. PENDING: the extraction of ~50 named constants and ~20 in-function literals across physics_solver.h, physics_flags.h, physics_system_v4.cpp, narrow_phase.cpp, explosion_detector.cpp, materials.h
origin: owner decree 2026-08-13, verbatim intent: constants are inputs that prepare and adjust the engine; separating constant-work from code-work keeps development honest
